Mission Local reported that Mayor Daniel Lurie accepted an amendment exempting buildings with three or more rent-controlled apartments from his upzoning plan. The newsroom’s analysis estimated it would exempt at least 84,000 rental units in 11,700 buildings, along with any ground-floor retail beneath them. Two-unit buildings were not covered; about 20,700 remained in the plan.
